controls.label: Prior alpha
controls.help: Raises Prior mean and Posterior alpha when increased, and pushes Posterior mean toward one.

controls.label: Prior beta
controls.help: Lowers Prior mean and raises Posterior beta when increased, and pushes Posterior mean toward zero.

controls.label: Observed successes s
controls.help: Each added success raises Posterior alpha and Posterior mean and makes the Shift result more positive.

controls.label: Observed failures f
controls.help: Each added failure raises Posterior beta and lowers Posterior mean, making the Shift result more negative.

explorations.title: Weak prior meets clear data
explorations.instruction: Predict: when the prior is nearly flat, does Priors mean or the data proportion dominate Posterior mean? Then apply the preset, which sets Prior alpha to 1, Prior beta to 1, Observed successes s to 8, and Observed failures f to 2.
explorations.observe: Prior mean holds at 0.5, Posterior alpha becomes 9 and Posterior beta becomes 3, so Posterior mean reads 0.75 and the bar for Posterior mean sits near the observed proportion 0.8.
explorations.why: A flat Beta prior counts as one success and one failure, so the eight successes dominate the update; adding counts to alpha and beta pulls Posterior mean toward the data and makes Shift positive.

explorations.title: Strong prior resists the same data
explorations.instruction: Predict: keeping Observed successes s at 8 and Observed failures f at 2, does Posterior mean change when the prior is concentrated? Then apply the preset, which sets Prior alpha to 10, Prior beta to 10, and keeps the counts fixed.
explorations.observe: Prior mean is 0.5 again, Posterior alpha becomes 18 and Posterior beta becomes 12, so Posterior mean reads only 0.6 and Shift is +0.1, a much shorter bar movement.
explorations.why: The prior now carries twenty pseudo-observations, so the ten observed trials move Posterior mean far less; the same additive update has a smaller relative effect, which is why Shift shrinks.
